paragraphs: EverTrue sells fundraising software built around prospect research, donor engagement, and stewardship. It is aimed at advancement teams, and the company says the software gives everyone on a team access to the information they need on mobile and desktop.

Screening uses AI to indicate capacity, past giving, and philanthropic affinity before an ask is made. A product called Signal identifies prospects showing capacity and readiness signals and automates the outreach that moves them along the pipeline. Video messages can be recorded once, sent to hundreds of donors, and tracked for engagement. Endowment tools automate fund calculations and produce real-time balances, board-ready reports, and audit trails.

The company describes users ranging from solo shops to top advancement offices. It says it is an Ellucian Strategic Partner and a Blackbaud Preferred HigherEd Partner. Integration with an existing database and technology stack is put at four weeks or less. One customer story describes KU Endowment launching a donor experience program and building a pipeline development strategy with the company.

quote.text: Find ready donors, reach them like humans, and keep them for life
